decks.name: Shadow Spectre Endymion
main: Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic
extra: Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Underworld Goddess of the Closed World
decks.manual:
GLOSSARY. **Spell Counter** = a token most cards in this deck bank each time a Spell resolves; nearly every Endymion/Mythical Beast Pendulum gains 1 (Jackal King and Master Cerberus gain 2) whenever ANY Spell resolves — yours or the opponent's. Counters are the deck's currency: you spend them to Special Summon, negate, banish, and destroy. **Scale / Pendulum Zone** = the two side zones; put a Pendulum monster in each and you may once per turn Pendulum Summon monsters whose Level is strictly between the two scale numbers, from hand and from face-up Pendulum monsters in your Extra Deck. **Face-up in the Extra Deck** = when a Pendulum monster would leave the field it lands face-up in the Extra Deck, where Magister of Endymion and Jackal King can re-summon it.

=== BIG PICTURE ===
You are a combo/control Spellcaster deck. You play a wall of cantrip Spells (3x Upstart Goblin, 3x Into the Void, Pot of Desires, the Spellbook mini-engine) whose ONLY real purpose is to make Spell Counters pile onto your Pendulum monsters and onto Magical Citadel / Mythical Institution. Once counters are stacked you convert them into a Special-Summon chain that ends on **Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic** as an omni-negate boss, backed by **Mythical Beast Jackal King** (monster-effect negate) and **Master Cerberus** (effect-destruction-immune 2800 beater with a banish). Citadel and Institution redirect destruction to counter-removal, so the board is very hard to break by popping.

=== THE ENGINE PIECES ===
- **Spell Power Mastery (3, your best starter):** adds ANY 'Endymion' card from Deck (grab Endymion the boss, or a Servant/Magister, or Magical Citadel), and places Spell Counters equal to how many Spell Power Mastery you control/GY (ramps as you play more copies). This one card is your search + your first counters.
- **Servant of Endymion (3):** in a Pendulum Zone it gains a counter per Spell; remove 3 counters to Special Summon ITSELF from the zone PLUS any 1000+ ATK counter-holder from Deck (fetch Master Cerberus / Jackal King / another Endymion). Its monster effect: once per opponent's turn discard 1 to place a counter on every card you control that can hold one — mass-loads counters before an Endymion wipe or to arm negates.
- **Magister of Endymion (2):** remove 3 counters to SS itself from the zone + revive 1 face-up monster from your Extra Deck; and once per opponent's turn remove 3 counters to SS a counter-holder from Deck (on-turn disruption/extension).
- **Reflection of Endymion (1):** remove 3 counters to SS itself + a monster from HAND; on Special Summon it bounces 1 opponent card AND 1 of your own counter-cards, re-banking the counters — a free interruption that recycles.
- **Mythical Beast Jackal (2, Level 1):** Pendulum effect self-destructs to seed a counter; monster effect removes 3 counters + tributes itself to SS a 'Mythical Beast' from Deck (tutor Jackal King / Master Cerberus / Bashilisk / Garuda). Being Level 1 it feeds Linkuriboh, Relinquished Anima, and Artemis.
- **Mythical Beast Master Cerberus (1, Level 8 / 2800):** Pendulum effect self-destructs to ADD a Lv7-or-lower Mythical Beast from Deck; monster effect is immune to effect destruction while 4+ counters sit on your field, and removes 4 counters to banish an opponent monster and steal its ATK.
- **Mythical Beast Jackal King (3):** on-board negate — banks 2 counters per Spell and, once per turn, removes 2 counters to negate+destroy an opponent's monster effect. Its Pendulum effect self-destructs to revive a Mythical Beast Pendulum from the Extra Deck. Three copies = layered negates.
- **Magical Abductor (1):** counter monster; remove 3 to add a Pendulum from Deck, or a Level-1 Spellcaster.
- **Mythical Beast Bashilisk (1):** Pendulum effect recycles a Spellcaster Pendulum from ED into the Deck AND draws 1; monster effect bounces a Mythical Beast back to hand.
- **Mythical Beast Garuda (1):** Pendulum effect destroys another S/T (and itself); monster effect is a soft handtrap — when the opponent summons, remove 3 counters to SS itself from hand and bounce their monster.
- **Field/Continuous banks:** **Magical Citadel of Endymion (2)** stores counters, lets you pay counter-costs from it, and survives destruction by removing 1 counter. **Mythical Institution (3)** is a Level-based tutor (remove N counters -> add a counter-holder of Level N from Deck or face-up ED) that also tanks destruction. **Mythical Bestiary (1)** mills 2 and places up to 2 counters; if destroyed it Special Summons a counter-holder from Deck.
- **Spellbook mini-engine:** Spellbook Magician of Prophecy searches Spellbook of Secrets -> Spellbook of Knowledge (dump a Spellcaster or Spellbook, draw 2). Extra Spell activations = extra counters, and it fuels **Crowley, the First Propheseer** in the Extra Deck.
- **Magia Magic - Thunder of Judgment (1):** a Magistus/Endymion Spell — pay a Magistus or 2 counters to EITHER Special Summon a Spellcaster from hand/face-up ED/GY, OR banish 1 card on the field. Flexible extender + spot removal, and pairs with Artemis (Magistus) in the Extra Deck.

=== A TYPICAL GOING-FIRST LINE ===
1) Resolve Spell Power Mastery: search Endymion the boss (or a missing piece) and bank your first counters. 2) Chain cheap Spells (Upstart, Into the Void once you hold 3+, Pot of Desires, the Spellbooks) to flood counters onto a Servant/Magister set in a Pendulum Zone and onto Citadel/Institution. 3) Spend counters: Servant SS's itself + a Deck monster; Magister revives from the Extra Deck; Jackal tutors a Mythical Beast; you build to **Heavymetalfoes Electrumite** (2 Pendulum monsters -> add a Pendulum from Deck; pop your own card to SS a Lv4-or-lower Pendulum from Deck) and then **Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians** (banks counters on summon, then removes 3 to revive a Spellcaster — into **Accesscode Talker** if you want damage). 4) Set the endboard: put **Endymion** in a Pendulum Zone or the Monster Zone (his Pendulum effect removes 6 counters to SS himself and destroy up to as-many-cards-as-you-control-that-hold-counters). Leave counters banked so Endymion has one (targeting- and destruction-immune) and Jackal King(s) can negate. Optionally hold **I:P Masquerena** to make **S:P Little Knight** (banish disruption) on the opponent's turn.

ENDBOARD (ideal): Endymion (Quick-Effect omni-negate: bounce your own counter-card to negate+destroy anything, protected while he holds a counter) + 1-2 Jackal King (monster-effect negate, 2 counters each) + Master Cerberus (effect-destruction-immune 2800, banish) + Magical Citadel + Mythical Institution banking counters, with S:P Little Knight or Apollousa as extra interruption from I:P Masquerena.

=== GOING SECOND ===
You are a strong turn-2 deck. **Triple Tactics Talent** (after the opponent uses a monster effect on your turn) draws 2, steals a monster, or peeks-and-shuffles. Dig with Pot of Desires / Upstart / Into the Void, load counters, then use **Endymion's Pendulum effect as a board wipe** (destroy up to N cards after stacking counter-holders), **Master Cerberus** and **Magia Magic** to banish, **Reflection / Garuda** to bounce, and **Underworld Goddess of the Closed World** (Link-5, uses an opponent's monster as material and negates on summon) or **Knightmare Unicorn** to punch through, finishing with **Accesscode Talker**.

=== HANDTRAP NAVIGATION ===
- **Called by the Grave (1)** answers Ash Blossom / Maxx "C" / Nibiru by banishing + negating the same-named effect.
- **Ash Blossom** on Spell Power Mastery or a Spellbook: you have redundancy (3x Mastery + Institution + Abductor + Servant/Jackal tutors) — eat it and continue with a different starter.
- **Maxx "C":** keep the line SHORT (Electrumite + one negate) or turn it around with Triple Tactics; don't over-extend into a free draw engine.
- **Nibiru, the Primal Being:** count your Special Summons — Endymion floods fast. Stop at 4 summons if Nibiru is live, or bait it; Endymion / Master Cerberus is your post-Nibiru beater and can rebuild off banked counters and cards face-up in the Extra Deck.
- **Droll & Lock Bird:** shuts the search engine — pivot to Pendulum Summoning the monsters already in hand and to Endymion's Pendulum wipe, which need no searching.

=== WEAKNESSES ===
- **Anti-Spell floodgates are lethal:** Anti-Spell Fragrance / Mystic Mine stop your Spells, which stops counters, which stops the entire engine. These are your worst matchup.
- **Droll & Lock Bird** cripples the cantrip/search chain.
- **Bounce/banish removal** (Evenly Matched, Lightning Storm, Forbidding, Kaijus) sidesteps Citadel/Institution, which only redirect DESTRUCTION.
- **Bricking:** hands of only high-scale pendulums with no starter stall you — but 3x Spell Power Mastery, Magical Abductor, Mythical Institution, and the Servant/Jackal tutors keep the starter count high.
- The board leans on counters; a first-Spell negate or a well-timed disruption before you bank counters slows the whole turn.

decks.name: Cimoooooooo Sky Striker
decks.manual:
**Game plan:** keep your Main Monster Zone EMPTY and grind the opponent out with a self-refuelling spell engine. Almost every Sky Striker card has the clause "If you control no monsters in your Main Monster Zone", so you deliberately field nothing there, fire off Quick-Play spells across BOTH turns, and win the long game on card quality. The whole deck snowballs on one number: **Spells in your GY**. At 3+ Spells in GY every core spell 'upgrades' (Engage draws, Hornet Drones' token becomes 1500, Widow Anchor steals instead of just negating, Afterburners also pops a backrow). So your turn-1 job is really 'dump spells into the GY and pass with open interaction'.

**The engine (memorize this):**
- **`Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage!` is the heart.** Controlling no MMZ monster, it searches ANY Sky Striker card, and if you already have 3+ Spells in GY it also draws 1. It is a one-card toolbox — grab Hornet Drones for a body, Widow Anchor for interaction, Area Zero for grind, Multirole for lock, or a second Engage line. Recur it every turn with Kagari (below).
- **`Sky Striker Mecha - Hornet Drones` makes your Link fodder.** Summons a Sky Striker Ace Token (its name counts as a 'Sky Striker Ace' monster, so it is legal material for the Ace Links). At 3+ Spells in GY the token is 1500/1500 instead of 0/0.
- **`Sky Striker Ace - Raye` is the free body.** Quick Effect: Tribute her to Special Summon an Ace Link from the Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone — do this on the OPPONENT'S turn so your MMZ is empty on your turn. From the GY she re-summons herself when one of your Ace Links is destroyed by battle or leaves by an opponent's effect, so she grinds forever. Search her with `Reinforcement of the Army`.
- **`Sky Striker Ace - Roze` (1-of extender):** Special Summons from hand when any Sky Striker Ace (including the Hornet token) is summoned, giving you a second body for a Link-2. ⚠ She lands in the MMZ, which temporarily disables the 'no MMZ monster' spells — so only bring her out to immediately Link her away (Raye + Roze -> Azalea / Zeke / = Zero).

**The Aces (Link-1s off one Sky Striker Ace monster) — when to make each:**
- **`Sky Striker Ace - Kagari` (FIRE):** on summon, ADD a Sky Striker Spell back from GY to hand. This is your recursion — get Engage back every turn to re-loop. Default Link on turns where you want to keep drawing/searching. Only once per turn.
- **`Sky Striker Ace - Shizuku` (WATER):** passively drops the opponent's whole board 100 ATK/DEF per Spell in your GY (can shrink a boss into range or into 0), and at End Phase searches a Sky Striker Spell with a fresh name. Great on defence / to set up next turn.
- **`Sky Striker Ace - Hayate` (WIND):** can attack directly, and after battling mills a Sky Striker card from Deck to GY (fuels the GY-Spell count and feeds Kagari). Your clock + engine-fuel Ace.
- **`Sky Striker Ace - Kaina` (EARTH):** on summon locks a monster out of attacking until end of the opponent's turn (a soft 'Kaiju-less' answer to a big beater), and gains you LP off every Sky Striker spell.
- **Link-2s:** `Sky Striker Ace - Azalea` (destroy any card on summon; can nuke a monster in battle by banishing a GY Spell), `Sky Striker Ace = Zero` (adds a Sky Striker Spell on summon and can tribute to bring back Raye + Roze AND pop a card — a huge grind reset), `Sky Striker Ace - Zeke` (banish a monster on Link Summon, then pump). Late-grind Link-3 payoffs: `Azalea Temperance` (equip-steal a monster <=2500 ATK) and `Knightmare Unicorn` (bounce ANY card).

**Interaction spells (play them on the OPPONENT'S turn):**
- **`Sky Striker Mecha - Widow Anchor`** — your best answer: negate a face-up Effect Monster this turn, and at 3+ Spells in GY STEAL it until the End Phase. Snatch their combo piece, then use it as Link material for your own Ace and hand back nothing. Chain it to a summon to cut a combo off.
- **`Sky Striker Maneuver - Afterburners!`** — target destroy a face-up monster (+1 backrow at 3+ Spells). Main-phase or your-turn removal. `Jamming Waves!` is the mirror: pop a Set S/T (+ a monster at 3+ Spells).
- **`Sky Striker Mecha - Shark Cannon`** — banish a monster from their GY, or at 3+ Spells STEAL it (it can't attack, but it's free Link fodder / graveyard hate vs revival decks).

**Grind / lock pieces:**
- **`Sky Striker Mecha Modules - Multirole`:** once/turn send a card you control to GY, and your opponent CANNOT respond to your Spell activations for the rest of the turn — this pushes your key spells through Ash/interaction. Its End-Phase effect re-SETS Sky Striker Spells from your GY (up to the number you activated while it was up) so next turn you fire them again. This is what makes the deck a true grind engine.
- **`Sky Striker Airspace - Area Zero`:** excavate 3 to add a Sky Striker card and send a card to GY (thins + feeds GY count); if it's ever sent to the GY it Special Summons a Sky Striker Ace from Deck. Fetch it with `Terraforming`.
- **`Sky Striker Mecharmory - Hercules Base`:** equip an Ace so it makes a second attack on monsters and draws when it kills at 3+ Spells — a slow, inevitable win condition in the mirror / vs stall.
- **`Foolish Burial Goods`** dumps a Sky Striker Spell to instantly turn on all the '3+ Spells in GY' clauses; `Pot of Desires` / the natural spell count keep the hand full.

**Going 1st:** DON'T over-commit. Fire Engage (search Widow Anchor + a body), get a couple Spells into the GY, make ONE Ace if useful (Shizuku to shrink / search, or just hold), SET Impermanence/Solemn, and pass with Widow Anchor + hand traps up. You want to interact on their turn, not build a fragile board.
**Going 2nd:** you're the control deck that loves it — Ash/Veiler/Impermanence their combo, then Widow Anchor to steal the survivor, Afterburners the rest, and rebuild your empty-field engine. Hornet Drones + Raye give bodies to Link off their leftovers.

**Weaknesses:** (1) the deck folds to being FORCED to have a monster in the MMZ (an opponent's mandatory Special Summon into your zone, or your own Roze left stranded) — everything shuts off. (2) Spell/Trap floodgates and anti-Special hate (Imperial Order, anti-search) hose the engine. (3) It's low-damage: without Hercules Base / Hayate it can durdle and get milled out or decked. (4) The 3+ Spells-in-GY threshold means your FIRST turn is weaker — GY hate (banishing your GY spells) resets that clock and cripples Kagari recursion.
